title: CatalogForm
description: Defines a Verifiable Presentation Request template. A Form specifies what Claims (and therefore which Verifiable Credentials) a relying party needs from a holder. Organized into Sections containing Fields that each reference a Claim. When a Form is activated, it can generate a standards-compliant Verifiable Presentation Request (aligned with DIF Presentation Exchange 2.0). When fulfilled by a holder, it produces a Verifiable Presentation.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4). Generated by the server on creation.

code.description: Globally unique SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE identifier (e.g. 'KYC_EU_BASIC', 'ONBOARDING_ES', 'AML_ENHANCED'). Immutable after creation.

version.description: Semantic version. Increment MAJOR when removing required Fields or changing CredentialRequirements in a breaking way.

purpose.description: Machine-readable English statement of why the data is being requested. Maps directly to the 'purpose' field of a W3C VP Request and DIF PE presentation_definition. Example: 'Verify identity for AML compliance under EU Directive 2015/849'.

translations.description: Multilingual metadata. Each key is a BCP 47 language tag.

default_lang_code.description: BCP 47 language tag for the primary language. MUST correspond to a key present in 'translations'.

state.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'active' forms can generate Verifiable Presentation Requests. Allowed transitions: draft → active → deprecated → archived.

compliance_regions.description: IDs of compliance_regions where this form is applicable. Determines in which regulatory contexts the form may be used.

credential_requirements.description: Declares which Verifiable Credential types (Documents) this form requests. Maps to DIF PE 'input_descriptors'. A relying party uses this list to build the presentation_definition before sending to the holder.

format_preferences.description: Preferred VC proof formats for the presentation response, ordered by preference (most preferred first). Maps to DIF PE 'format' object.

response_expiry_seconds.description: Time in seconds after which a Verifiable Presentation submitted in response to this form is considered expired. Maps to 'exp' in the VP JWT or 'expiresAt' in the VP request.

sections.description: Ordered list of sections composing the form. The presentation order follows the array index.

label.description: Display title of the form shown in portals and wallet prompts.

description.description: Longer explanation of the form's purpose shown in detail views and landing pages.

short_label.description: Compact label for navigation, breadcrumbs and list items.

submit_label.description: Label for the primary action button (e.g. 'Submit', 'Share Credentials', 'Verify Identity').

purpose_display.description: Translated version of the English 'purpose' field, shown to the data subject to explain why their data is needed.

FormTranslationMap.description: Keys are BCP 47 language tags. E.g. { 'es': { 'label': 'KYC Básico' }, 'en': { 'label': 'Basic KYC' } }

CredentialRequirement.description: Declares one Verifiable Credential type that this form needs. Multiple requirements are combined with AND logic by default. Requirements sharing a 'group' are combined with OR logic (any one satisfies the group). Aligns with DIF Presentation Exchange 'input_descriptor'.

document_code.description: Code of the Document (VC type) being requested. MUST reference an existing active Document.

purpose.description: Specific purpose for requesting this credential type, overriding the form-level purpose for this credential. Used in the DIF PE input_descriptor.purpose.

required.description: When false, this credential is optional — the form can be submitted without it.

group.description: Group identifier for OR logic. All CredentialRequirements with the same group label form an OR group — the holder needs to provide at least one credential from the group. Null means this requirement stands alone (AND logic).

FormSection.description: A logical group of form fields. Sections allow organizing claims by topic (e.g. 'Personal Data', 'Address', 'Identity Document'). Aligns with DIF PE 'input_descriptor_group' concept.

translations.description: Multilingual title and description for this section.

sort_order.description: Display order relative to other sections within the same form. Lower values appear first.

fields.description: Ordered list of fields within this section.

title.description: Section heading shown to the data subject.

description.description: Optional explanatory text displayed beneath the section heading.

FormField.description: A single presentable input within a form section. References a Claim and may override its display and validation properties for the specific context of this form.

section_id.description: The section this field belongs to. Null means the field is unsectioned (belongs to the form root).

claim_id.description: Reference to the Claim this field collects or requests. One claim may appear at most once per form.

label_override_translations.description: Multilingual label overrides for this field, scoped to this form. When provided, replaces the claim's default translations.label for each language.

help_text_translations.description: Multilingual help text overrides for this field, scoped to this form.

required.description: Whether this field MUST be provided by the holder when submitting the form. Overrides the claim-level 'essential' property for this form's context.

or_group_index.description: Fields sharing the same or_group_index within a form satisfy the requirement with OR logic — providing any one field from the group is sufficient. Null means the field is required independently (AND logic).

origin_reference.description: JSONPath expression indicating where to extract the claim value from a credential (e.g. '$.credentialSubject.address.streetAddress'). Used in automated credential parsing.

widget_ui.description: UI widget hint override for this specific field, overriding the claim-level display.widget.

constraints_override.description: Partial JSON Schema constraints that override the claim-level constraints for this form context. Only keys present in this object override the claim defaults; absent keys fall through to the claim definition.

sort_order.description: Display order within the section (or form root if unsectioned). Lower values appear first.
